title: CodeHealthCampaign
description: Code-health campaign manifest binding candidates, evidence indexes, revisions, environments, and append-only ledger policy.

createdAt.description: UTC time at which the campaign manifest was created.

baseline.description: Source revision against which campaign evidence is interpreted.

environmentMatrix.description: Supported environments and their observed status; unavailable required environments do not pass.

items.description: One supported or explicitly unsupported environment observation.

candidateIds.description: Stable candidate identifiers included in this campaign.

ledgerPath.description: Repository-relative JSONL path for append-only ledger events.

evidencePath.description: Repository-relative JSONL path for evidence records.

approvalPath.description: Repository-relative JSONL path for human approval records.

archivePath.description: Repository-relative JSONL path for terminal archive records.

appendOnly.description: Whether ledger and index records are append-only.

sourceBundleSha256.description: SHA-256 of the analyzed source bundle.

analyzedAt.description: UTC time at which this revision was analyzed.

environment.description: One platform, shell, and runtime observation.

platform.description: Platform identifier such as win32 or linux.

shell.description: Shell identifier used for the observation.

supported.description: Whether the campaign requires this environment.

reason.description: Specific reason for the observed status.

allOf.description: A required environment cannot be represented as a passing observation when unavailable.

then.description: Required environments must have an observed command result.

redaction.description: Redaction result for a campaign artifact.

status.description: Whether the artifact is safe to export.

blockedReasons.description: Reasons export is blocked, if any.

allOf.description: Every required environment in a campaign must have an observed result; unavailable is never a pass.

if.description: Campaign contains a required environment that is not observed.

contains.description: A required environment with a non-observed result.

then.description: A required non-observed environment invalidates the campaign manifest.
